# StackedBarChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders multiple series stacked on each category, in absolute or 100% normalized mode.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new StackedBarChart(options?: StackedBarChartOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`barStyle`](#barstyle): Corner rounding and gradient style applied to stacked bar segments.
- [`barWidthRatio`](#barwidthratio): Fraction of each category slot occupied by the bar (`0..1`).
- [`mode`](#mode): Stacking mode: `absolute` (default) or 100% normalized `percent`.
- [`segmentGap`](#segmentgap): Visual gap between adjacent stacked segments in points.
- [`showStackTotals`](#showstacktotals): Whether to draw the category total beyond the top of each stacked bar.
- [`stackTotalFormat`](#stacktotalformat): Number format for category stack totals.
- [`svgShapeRendering`](#svgshaperendering): SVG `shape-rendering` hint (`auto` or `crispEdges`).
